$comment: The Marvel brief, run cold a second time. In September the same brief produced a deck its owner rated 2-3/10 that passed every gate the skill had. This run passes every gate too - and a taste review against references/taste-review.md rated it 5/10 and named six blockers, none of which any gate can see. That is the whole value of the record: the numbers moved and the gap that remains is a different gap.

againstClientWork.$comment: The same vision rubric the 132 client pages were judged with, run over these 44 content pages.

foundByLooking.seen: A table split over two pages draws its in-cell bars at two different scales - 0 to 1500 on the first half, 0 to 450 on the second - so a $440m bar is drawn longer than a $1,148m bar one page earlier. Repeated on the appendix pair.
foundByLooking.gateable: A split table's halves share one scale, or carry none. `paginateTable` already knows it split the rows; nothing makes it share the scale.

foundByLooking.seen: A five-step staircase inside a plot frame with an axis, whose blocks are all 75px tall while the values printed on them are 126, 143, 136, 148 and 330 minutes. The 330-minute payoff is drawn the same size as the 126-minute opener.
foundByLooking.gateable: A mark carrying a printed value must be drawn to it. Nothing checks that a figure's geometry agrees with its own labels.

foundByLooking.seen: The answer page and the closing takeaway state the screen answer as Marvel unconditionally; three later pages recommend DC on screen for the one-evening reader.
foundByLooking.gateable: CONTENT_ANSWER_UNCARRIED checks the claims carry the answer. Nothing checks they do not contradict it.

foundByLooking.seen: Three axis categories printed on top of one another ('Superman (2025)ther DC featuAlsDC features'); a period bracket rule struck through a legend; two-line category labels colliding into one seven-line block.
foundByLooking.gateable: Label collision is measurable off the scene's own frames - the renderer knows where it put every label.

foundByLooking.seen: Both halves of an appendix table carry a Total row that sums the 'Multiple (x budget)' column: 41.4 and 30.9. A sum of budget multiples is not a quantity.
foundByLooking.gateable: `totalRow` knows which columns it is summing. A ratio column has no total.

foundByLooking.seen: Half a page is an empty gradient rectangle, with body text beside it explaining that the frame holds a specimen image because the characters are trademarked.
foundByLooking.gateable: PLAN_NO_PICTURES has no honest opt-out, so a deck about trademarked subjects is pushed into printing an apology for an empty box.

foundByLooking.seen: Commentary blocks headed 'Six of the twelve are DC' beside a chart whose labels are tagged '(DC)'; bar sub-labels repeating the bar labels word for word.
foundByLooking.gateable: RESTATEMENT measures this and did not fire: 93% of these pages carry a commentary column against 33% in client work, and the overlap sits under the threshold because the column is long enough to dilute it.

skillGapsReportedByTheAuthor: The plan stage has no schema and no example: SKILL.md never mentions .plan.json, storylining.md documents it as a markdown table, build-deck.mjs reads JSON, and plan_gates.mjs reads fields documented nowhere.

Most build failures are hard crashes with no sizing guidance ('Unbreakable text exceeds its width', 'Cards need 232px but have 217px'). Nothing states the width a side-column exhibit gets, so the method is guess-and-rebuild. ~70% of the author's iterations.
`agenda: "once"` does the opposite of what SKILL.md says and emitted six agenda pages.
`highlights` accepts exactly one entry while the plan gate's repair text asks for 'a highlighted category'.
`paragraphs` is silently dropped when points carry leads, then fails the build as MISSING_AUTHORED_CONTENT.
Four icon-led points cannot be composed: 'three across, four to six as a grid of three' produces rows of 3+1 and crashes on 'Cards take two to six items'.
THIN_PLAN's word count reads only `items`/`rows`, so quadrants, framework pillars, compare columns and trees count as zero words.
SKILL.md says a highlight that does not occur in the point 'is an error rather than a silent no-op'. It is a no-op, and it never reaches cards, framework pillars or compare columns.
